services.title: Auto Insurance
services.summary: Liability, collision and more for Texas drivers.
services.text: We offer many types of auto insurance coverage, from liability to collision, and will help you find a policy to meet your unique needs.
services.lead: Are you in the market for auto insurance? Auto insurance is necessary because it helps to protect following an accident. We offer many types of auto insurance coverage, from liability to collision.
services.imageAlt: A driver standing beside her car on a hillside road

covers.title: Liability
covers.text: Legally required in Texas. It covers medical and funeral expenses in addition to lost wages in the event of a severe accident, and it also covers property damage.

covers.title: Collision
covers.text: Covers damage to your vehicle if you are still actively paying for it following an accident with another vehicle.

covers.title: Comprehensive
covers.text: Covers damage to your vehicle if you are still actively paying for it following damage from an object, vandalism, storms and the like.

covers.title: Uninsured and underinsured
covers.text: Covers medical and property damage expenses if you are involved in an accident with a driver who does not have insurance.

covers.title: Roadside assistance
covers.text: Helps if you are stranded on the side of the road. It offers fuel delivery, flat tire changes and more.

questions.q: What auto insurance does Texas require?
questions.a: Texas requires all drivers to obtain auto insurance and to meet the minimum liability limits: bodily injury coverage of $30,000 for each person, $60,000 for each accident, and property damage coverage of $25,000.

questions.q: What happens if I drive without insurance?
questions.a: If you are caught without auto insurance and are involved in an accident, the fines and consequences can be pretty extreme.

services.title: Home Insurance
services.summary: Cover for your home, property and belongings.
services.text: Home insurance covers physical damage to your personal belongings, property and home, and may also help provide coverage for injuries or accidents on your property or inside your home.
services.lead: If you own a home, you should consider protecting it with a home insurance policy. Allow us to help you find a customized policy that meets your needs.
services.imageAlt: A white house with a wraparound porch under a blue sky

covers.title: Dwelling
covers.text: Covers repair or rebuilding expenses if your home becomes damaged, including repairing damaged structures attached to your home.

covers.title: Other structures
covers.text: Covers repair or rebuilding expenses for structures on your property that are not permanently attached to your home, such as a guest house, fence or detached garage.

covers.title: Personal property
covers.text: If your furniture, appliances or electronics become damaged or stolen, this covers replacing them, depending on your policy limits.

covers.title: Loss of use
covers.text: If you need to temporarily live elsewhere while your home is being repaired, this covers restaurant meals, hotel stays and the like.

covers.title: Personal liability
covers.text: If you cause injuries to another person, this covers their medical bills and legal fees.

covers.title: Medical payments to others
covers.text: Covers another party's medical bills if they sustain minor injuries, no matter who is liable.

questions.q: Is home insurance required in Texas?
questions.a: Home insurance is not mandatory in the state of Texas. However, your lender can require you to purchase it, especially if you still owe money on your home.

services.title: Flood Insurance
services.summary: A separate policy for flood damage.
services.text: Most home insurance policies do not cover flood damage, so it is vital to have a separate flood insurance policy. We can make sure you get the right coverage for flood damage.
services.lead: Flooding can cause thousands of dollars' worth of damage. Without flood insurance, this cost would all come out of your pocket, leaving your finances in shambles. There is a high risk of flooding in Texas, meaning that if you live in Texas, you might want flood insurance.
services.imageAlt: A flooded residential street beside a white fence

covers.title: Building coverage
covers.text: Electrical and plumbing systems, water heaters, furnaces, attached cabinets, bookcases and paneling, carpet, built-in appliances, window blinds, foundation walls and staircases, detached garages, fuel tanks, water tanks and pumps, and solar energy equipment.

covers.title: Content coverage
covers.text: Personal belongings, washer and dryer, curtains, microwave, valuable items and portable air conditioners.

covers.title: Other coverage
covers.text: Temporary housing and living expenses, other property outside of the building, business interruption, valuable papers, currency and precious metals, cars and their parts, and personal property kept in basements.

questions.a: It is not a state requirement, but if you live in a high flood area there is a chance that your lender will require flood insurance as well as home insurance.

questions.q: Is there anything flood insurance does not cover?
questions.a: Although flood insurance covers many things, it does not include damage from sewer backups.

services.title: Life Insurance
services.text: You pay a premium to ensure your loved ones or beneficiaries are paid a certain amount when you die. There are two types of life insurance policies: term life insurance and permanent life insurance.
services.lead: Life insurance helps pay for your funeral and burial costs, pays your debt, helps send your kids to college, and takes care of your family's other financial needs after you die.

covers.title: Term
covers.text: Term life insurance expires and only lasts for a predetermined time. You can get a 10-year, 20-year or 30-year policy, and you can also have a policy that converts to a permanent policy.

covers.title: Permanent
covers.text: Permanent life insurance covers you from when you buy your policy until you die or stop paying your premium. It has a cash value option that you can take out and use for loans, paying debts and paying policy premiums.

questions.a: Unlike other types of insurance, you do not receive your life insurance benefits. The money goes to your loved ones as a death benefit.

questions.q: How does life insurance benefit me?
questions.a: Having life insurance can give you peace of mind. You do not have to worry about how much your family might struggle financially after you are gone.

services.title: Umbrella Insurance
services.summary: Cover above the limits of your other policies.
services.text: Umbrella insurance takes over where other types of insurance cap out, so that an expensive lawsuit does not leave your assets at risk.
services.lead: Home, auto and other types of insurance have limitations, and you will only be covered up to a certain maximum amount. Your net worth could be much higher than these maximum coverage amounts. With umbrella insurance, you can enjoy complete financial protection of your full net worth.

questions.q: How do I choose an umbrella policy?
questions.a: Make sure you are fully informed about umbrella coverage, then request quotes so you can see the options available and make an informed choice.

services.title: Condo Insurance
services.summary: Cover for your unit, contents and liability.
services.text: An individual condo insurance policy typically covers personal property, personal liability, and the walls and fixtures within an individual condo unit.
services.lead: Condo insurance can be a bit complicated because both individual condo owners and condo communities carry insurance. Consumers who own condos need to understand what condo insurance covers and what their condo association's policy covers.

covers.title: Your unit
covers.text: Personal property, personal liability, and the walls and fixtures within an individual condo unit.

covers.title: Association coverage
covers.text: Condo association coverage usually covers shared parts of a condominium structure, which is a separate policy from your own.

questions.a: It protects the personal belongings of a condo owner and protects their assets through the liability coverage it includes. It is also often required by lenders that finance the purchase of a condo.

services.title: Boat and Watercraft Insurance
services.summary: Liability and damage cover for boat owners.
services.text: We offer coverage for boat owners in Texas. You need to understand your boat insurance options to get a policy that will offer you financial protection.
services.lead: The most crucial reason boat owners should have boat insurance coverage is to protect themselves financially. Marinas often require boat insurance, and lenders require it on boat loans.

covers.title: Liability for property damage
covers.text: If your boating activities damage another party's property, you could be held liable and therefore need property damage coverage.

covers.title: Liability for bodily injury
covers.text: Boat accidents could lead to bodily injury expenses. Boat insurance can cover this expense.

covers.title: Collision and comprehensive
covers.text: With these types of coverage, you will be compensated for damages to your own boat or watercraft.

services.title: Classic Car Insurance
services.summary: Agreed-value cover for a classic vehicle.
services.text: Classic cars tend to have unique insurance needs, so it is best to take out a policy explicitly geared toward classic car coverage.
services.lead: Classic cars may be worth more than standard automobiles, and at the same time might not be used as frequently as a car you drive every day. That is why you need a policy specifically designed for classic car coverage.

covers.title: Agreed value
covers.text: Classic car policies are often agreed-value policies, which means you pay for a certain amount of coverage that will not be affected by depreciation in your vehicle's value.

covers.title: Usage restrictions
covers.text: Classic car insurance usually has usage restrictions, which is why you cannot take out a classic car policy on your daily commuting vehicle.

services.title: Motorcycle Insurance
services.summary: Cover for your bike, gear and liability.
services.text: Motorcycle insurance includes a variety of options for coverage such as property damage, bodily injury, comprehensive and more. We can help you find a policy that meets your needs.
services.lead: Owning a motorcycle is like owning any other vehicle. You have to make sure that you protect your investment by purchasing an insurance policy.

covers.title: Collision and comprehensive
covers.text: Both are considered full coverage. Collision covers your repair costs or the costs to replace your motorcycle; comprehensive covers your bike when it is stolen, vandalized or damaged by storms. Full coverage will only cover standard or factory parts.

covers.title: Total loss
covers.text: If your motorcycle is totaled following an accident, this covers the retail value of your bike towards its replacement. It may only be available for several years of your bike's life.

covers.title: Personal belongings and carried contents
covers.text: Covers possessions you carry with you while riding, such as cell phones and bike gear, if they are stolen or damaged.

covers.title: Roadside assistance
covers.text: If you are stranded, this covers battery failure, flat tires, fuel delivery and more.

questions.q: What does Texas require for a motorcycle?
questions.a: All drivers are legally required to have motorcycle insurance in Texas. The minimums are bodily injury coverage of $30,000 for each person, $60,000 for each accident, and property damage coverage of $25,000.

services.title: Pet Insurance
services.summary: Health cover for cats and dogs.
services.text: Pet insurance is essentially a type of health insurance for animals. Some insurance companies cover things that others do not, so it is crucial to determine what your company covers before signing up for a policy.
services.lead: While pet insurance is good to have, there will still be some out-of-pocket costs. Most policies have a maximum limit for the year, and there is still a deductible to pay, so it is best to check your policy to know the limit and keep track of what you have already used.

covers.title: What most policies cover
covers.text: Unexpected accidents and injuries, illnesses, medications, surgery, emergency exams, and tests and diagnostics.

covers.title: What some policies add
covers.text: Behavior modification, alternative therapies, lost pet advertising and rewards, hospital boarding, chiropractic, hydrotherapy, acupuncture, and nursing and whelping.

covers.title: What most policies do not cover
covers.text: Conditions that existed before the policy, routine wellness exams, preventative care, vaccinations, and spay or neuter.

questions.q: How does a pet insurance claim work?
questions.a: When your pet goes to the vet, you are responsible for paying the vet. You file a claim with your insurance company, and they reimburse you after investigating the claim.

services.title: Commercial Insurance
services.text: Commercial insurance helps protect businesses and companies from loss, and is a great way to stop yourself and your company from falling into substantial financial losses.
services.lead: Although Texas does not require liability insurance or worker's compensation, it is wise to have commercial insurance for your business. Without insurance, your business is in danger of going under or suffering financial damage.

covers.title: General liability
covers.text: When accidents occur, liability insurance compensates for injury or damage to a customer's property. In a lawsuit, the insurance company pays for the legal costs.

covers.title: Worker's compensation
covers.text: If your employee gets hurt doing their job, worker's compensation can cover their financial needs and medical bills until they can return to work.

covers.title: Property insurance
covers.text: Protects against damage that might occur to the physical property of your business from fire, theft, vandalism or weather-related causes.

covers.title: Business interruption insurance
covers.text: If a fire or a natural disaster stops you from running your business, this can help with the income you would otherwise lose.

covers.title: Commercial auto insurance
covers.text: Covers your company vehicles and the employees driving them.

covers.title: Cyber liability insurance
covers.text: A lot of businesses hold important records online, which can make them targets of cybercrime. Cyber insurance can help protect you against damage from cyber criminals.

questions.q: Is commercial insurance required in Texas?
questions.a: Texas does not require liability insurance or worker's compensation, but it is wise to have commercial insurance for your business.

about.title: A Friendswood agency Diann opened in 2009.
text: Diann began her insurance career in 1983, working with several State Farm agents helping them meet sales goals to obtain their contracts. Through those years she raised her family, and then in 2009 took a leap of faith and opened her own agency. She wonders what took so long to do so.

Roberts Family Insurance is a Texas independent agency and your local choice for insurance in Friendswood, TX. We believe that personalized service is key to building strong, lasting relationships with our clients, and we are dedicated to understanding your specific needs and providing a tailored insurance solution that is both affordable and comprehensive.

We are more than just an insurance agency; we are your neighbors. Whether you are a homeowner, a business owner, or an individual seeking peace of mind, we are here to help you protect what matters most.
